query: A product has desktop web and native mobile clients. A backend change renames a user-visible lifecycle status, while a separate backend change only adds an internal query index. Explain which changes need design-contract review and how to approach a native screen that uses the shared product workflow.
expected_behavior: Checks design intent for the user-visible lifecycle rename despite the backend file path
Skips design-contract review for the internal query index when it has no user-visible effect
Applies the same product intent to native mobile with explicitly scoped platform variants and suitable native evidence
Does not impose CSS token tooling or browser-only checks on native code
